<translate>
The '''Red Ribbon Tower''' is a Red Ribbon outpost on [[Special:MyLanguage/Earth|Earth]]. Its walls keep spawning [[Special:MyLanguage/Red Ribbon Army|Red Ribbon]] soldiers and robots, and two early story fights take place there.
</translate>

<translate>
== The garrison ==
</translate>
{{Main|Red Ribbon Army}}
<translate>
* The tower keeps spawning Red Ribbon soldiers (in groups of 2–4) and robots (in groups of 1–2) inside its walls, in dim spots (block light 7 or less).
* Vanilla monsters don't spawn inside it.
* Outside the tower, the same soldiers and robots also patrol the land around savanna, plains and snowy villages.
</translate>

<translate>
== Finding it ==
</translate>
<translate>
Red Ribbon Towers generate in most land biomes. Players with the locate permission can use {{Command|/dmzlocate rrtower}} to find the nearest one.
</translate>

<translate>
== In the story ==
</translate>
<translate>
* [[Special:MyLanguage/Classic Saga|Classic Saga]] quest 21, ''Red Ribbon Headquarters'': defeat General Red at the Red Ribbon Tower.
* Classic Saga quest 22, ''Officer Black's Battle Robot'': defeat General Black's Robot at the Red Ribbon Tower.
</translate>
